about_the_game:
"Knock on Fate: The Guardian Pusher" is a single-player simulation coin pusher game focused on physics interaction and long-term progression.
Within the "Tiangong Pavilion" guarded by the Asura statue, you will experience a progressive journey of "Securing Treasures."

🎯 Core Gameplay: Knock on the Bagua
Everything begins with a shot. Operate your cannon and aim at the dynamic "Bagua Mechanism" in the center of the board.

  • Minimalist Shooting: Simply aim left or right and fire. You can also mimic offline coin pushers by firing without aiming—define your own playstyle and experience realistic collisions and bounces.

  • Heavenly Mystery: Hitting the Bagua mechanism not only grants rewards based on light colors and activates the Slot Machine but also gives a chance to trigger events like "Divine Dragon's Gift" and "Yin-Yang Harmony," bringing a rich gaming experience.

  • Perfect Timing: Observe the mechanism's fluctuations carefully and hit at the right moment to win massive rewards!

🏔️ Physics Spectacle: Sand into Tower

  • Coin Tower: When coins pile up on the board, you can actively trigger a mechanism to reorganize scattered coins into a physical Coin Tower.

  • Ultimate Stress Relief: Push down this tower with your own hands and enjoy the physical satisfaction of coins pouring down like an avalanche.

🐉 Advanced Challenge: Dragon Trial
After obtaining the "Dragon Palace Secret," the special "Dragon Trial" phase unlocks. The white "Dragon Pearl" balls become your ticket and opportunity. Plan cleverly, accumulate "Dragon Pearls," and face the challenge! This is not just a game of luck, but a gamble of strategy.

  • Tool Strategy: Use mechanism tools like the "Dragon Gate" to raise barriers before the trial starts, temporarily intercepting Dragon Pearls and coins on the pusher to "hoard" them.

  • Unleash the Hoard: When the time is right, release the gate, let the hoarded resources flood in at once, enjoy the thrill of the Multi-ball Wheel, and win the field-clearing Jackpot!

🏺 Long-term Progression: Collection & Appraisal
The tickets you win are the key to becoming a collector.

  • Treasures of Jiuzhou: Use tickets in the shop to buy nearly a hundred digital collectibles designed with reference to Chinese historical artifacts.

  • Appraisal & Grading: After obtaining a collectible, you can hire four appraisers with distinct styles to "Identify" it.

  • Free Building: Appraised collectibles allow you to choose desired buff effects. Through collection and appraisal, you can permanently increase Luck for probability events, raise Coin caps, and even alter physics rules to build your own exclusive playstyle.

😌 Player Friendly: Zen & Packs

  • Zen Mode: Built-in "Cyber Wooden Fish" mechanic acts as a safety net, helping you accumulate Merit and stage a comeback when resources run out.

  • Various Packs: Starter Packs, Daily Packs, and Online Coin Packs are all free to claim, ensuring a smooth gaming experience!

🎮 Multiple Control Modes: The game defaults to keyboard controls that recreate the arcade experience, but also supports Controllers. You can also select "Mouse Only Mode" in the settings to play the entire game with just one hand!

Full Multi-Language Support: The game currently supports 9 languages. If your language is not included, please contact me, and I will add it for you！

💎 Game Promise

  • Worry-free Experience: One-time purchase, complete experience. No in-app purchases, no microtransactions or gacha. All wealth is seized by your skill and strategy.

A Word from the Developer:
Hello, dear players! I am the solo developer of this indie game. I made this game simply because I wasn't satisfied with real-life coin pushers. Since its release, the game has been constantly evolving. Much of the content has evolved from my original design core combined with the suggestions and criticisms from you, the players, after careful thought and redesign. I adhere to an attitude of serving the players. If you have any suggestions or dissatisfaction during your playthrough, please feel free to communicate with me. I will do my best to give you the best gaming experience in the world of "Knock on Fate"!

🌐 Find me here:

  • Bilibili: I share development videos and updates here.

  • QQ Group: 1073054003 - Welcome to join the chat and discuss gameplay!

Thank you to every player for your support!
